line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.scope: Compared complete logical line streams, before/after metrics, selected host bindings and existing callback controls; no new runtime test.

decision: Removed eleven redundant unconditional #line directives after verifying identical (logical line, source text) pairs for all remaining non-marker lines. Kept all excluded-branch markers. R2197/R2198: created native HWND and attached menu cleanup; R2199: public dialog-proc slot and ANSI state owned by native dialog. R2201/2202/2203/2205/2206: font, edit allocator, child creation and dialog-code callbacks may destroy the parent. Returning an edit allocation to an invalid dialog loses its owner. Prior edge1/2/5 controls fault on restoration. No executable code changed.
